data.name: Golden Hour Adventure from Samet Nangshe to James Bond Island
data.description: Enjoy a breathtaking sunrise at Samet Nangshe viewpoint overlooking Phang Nga Bay, followed by a longtail boat tour to James Bond Island. Explore the stunning Talu Island by canoe before visiting a Muslim village and the famous Manee Si Mahathat Temple.Start your day with a thrilling early morning pick-up and journey to the iconic Samet Nangshe viewpoint. Be captivated by the mesmerizing panorama of the bay as the first rays of sunlight paint the sky in vibrant hues. Embark on a long-tail boat adventure through the enchanting Phang Nga Bay National Park, where towering limestone cliffs and emerald waters create a surreal landscape. Visit the world-famous James Bond Island and marvel at the iconic Khao Ping Kan rock formation.For a truly unique experience, paddle through the hidden lagoons and caves of Talu Island in a canoe. Immerse yourself in the tranquillity of nature as you explore this pristine paradise. Your adventure continues with a visit to the vibrant Muslim Village of Koh Panyee, followed by a delicious lunch. Discover the cultural heritage of the region at Manee Si Mahathat Temple before returning to Phuket, filled with unforgettable memories.

data.name: Phi Phi Islands Sunrise Excursion from Phuket
data.description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to the Phi Phi Islands, departing from Phuket in the early morning tranquillity before the throngs of tourists flock to the islands. The first stop is the awe-inspiring Maya Bay, a sight that must not be missed.Next, set sail for Phileh Lagoon, famed for its traditional boat-jump into one of the world's most exquisite lagoons. For those who prefer a gentler approach, there are steps leading into the crystal clear waters. You are also offered a selection of prime snorkeling spots such as Viking Cove, Loh Somah Bay, and Straight Rock. The friendly staff is always on hand, both in and out of the water, ready to assist with equipment or offer encouragement to first-timers.After a delightful encounter with the locals on Monkey Beach, land on Bamboo Island for a beachside lunch amidst powdery white sands. Post-lunch, prepare for more underwater exploration at Nui Bay (Camel Rock), Mosquito Island, Hin Klan, or a spot in front of Bamboo Island, teeming with coral reefs and abundant sea life. Upon returning to the marina, a comfortable vehicle awaits to transport you back to your hotel. This tour promises an immersive experience of the Phi Phi Islands' natural splendor and rich marine biodiversity.

data.name: Andamanda Water Park Ticket
data.description: Phuket's biggest leisure centre will be your destination on this wet and wild day out. With five themed zones, there's attractions for everyone at Andamanda - whether it be daring to ride the pulse-racing Eagle Flyer, racing against your friends on the Racing Nagas, or relaxing with a drink in hand at the Sand Bar. A perfect family day out for everyone.

data.name: Phuket Island tour with Big Buddha and iconic locations
data.description: This photo tour offers a curated experience for photography enthusiasts and travellers keen to capture Phuket's most iconic and photogenic spots. You'll visit a selection of stunning locations across the island, ensuring picture-perfect moments for your social media feeds.The journey begins at Patong Beach, where you can photograph blonde sands framed by turquoise waters and dramatic offshore rock formations. At Karon Viewpoint, you'll enjoy panoramic vistas of three beaches: Kata, Kata Noi, and Karon. Promthep Cape, at Phuket's southern tip, provides a scenic coastline backdrop for photos. The tour also includes a stop at Wat Chalong, one of Phuket's most venerated temples, where you can admire the Siamese architecture and observe local Buddhist practices.A highlight of the tour is the Big Buddha statue, a significant landmark visible from Phuket Town and Karon Beach. Perched atop a hill between Chalong and Kata, this 45-metre-tall statue offers impressive views of the surrounding area, adding another dimension to your photographic adventure.The tour concludes at Gems Gallery International, the biggest gem store and factory in the world. You can choose to stay at there for as long as you want, or leave straight away. Your guide will see that you receive transportation back to your hotel immediately upon your request

data.name: Phi Phi Islands Tour From Phuket with Lunch
data.description: Visit the most famous spots of the Phi Phi Islands, its pristine beaches, and landscapes, and jump into the clear waters for a swim and a snorkel.Start your tour in the early morning in order to avoid the crowds. Stop at the island Phi Phi Leh, with its unique Maya Bay, which was made famous by the Hollywood movie The Beach, and the Phi Phi Leh Lagoon. Take time for a refreshing swimming break in the lagoon. After, continue to Phi Phi Don to climb up to the striking viewpoint. Enjoy the amazing views from the top of the island and get a glimpse of the town.Tuck into a delicious lunch later in the day and enjoy drinks aboard the speedboat. Have the opportunity to sight see around the island to see the Viking Cave and see the monkeys from the boat. Make the most of a long snorkeling stop, and, as a final stop, head to Bamboo Island for a picnic lunch and extensive beach and swimming time.

data.name: Evening Siam Niramit Phuket Ticket Silver Class
data.description: Experience the wonder of Siam Niramit Phuket, one of the island's premier cultural performances. This spectacular show transports you through Thailand's history, traditions, and spirituality in one of the world's largest stage productions. The show starts at 20:30, but gates open at 17:30 for access to the restaurant and other on-site attractions.Featuring over 100 performers in elaborate costumes, Siam Niramit Phuket captivates with state-of-the-art special effects across three acts. The performance takes you on a vivid journey through Thailand's historical regions, from mystical interpretations of the Himapaan Forest and Heaven to the depths of Hell, all based on ancient Thai beliefs.Each scene is a blend of colour, music, and dance that illustrates key moments from Thailand's past and festive traditions that highlight the Thai spirit. Beyond the dazzling spectacle, the show offers a deeper understanding of Thai culture and philosophy. It's a world-class performance showcasing Thailand's arts and cultural heritage.

This island also has some great snorkeling locations and authentic Thai Restaurants.During this tour you'll go on a Private Boat Tour, and you'll discover Phi Phi in the best conditions, with the least amount of tourists. data.name: Hype Luxury Catamaran Experience
data.description: Following departure from Chalong Pier between 11am-11.30am, enjoy a Welcome Drink and settle into a days cruise to beautiful islands and across the lovely waters off the Andaman Sea aboard a stunning 22 metre long catamaran. Onboard you can lie back and sunbathe, you'll have access to the open air shower and be able to enjoy the bars extensive Drinks Menu.  Arriving at Racha Yai by 3.15pm, take advantage of your complimentary snorkelling equipment and the clear blue waters as you are at one of the best snorkelling areas around.  By 4.30pm you will be back on the cat to return to Chalong Pier for two glorious, relaxing hours passing by Promthep Cape at sunset.

data.name: Whitewater Rafting and ATV Adventure
data.description: This ATV adventure takes you deep into the jungle, past farms and plantations. Both challenging and achievable, the 4WD trails carry on beside rivers and through streams. Enjoy a refreshing swim at a remote waterfall then experience more fun and thrills during 5 kilometres of whitewater rafting. Be picked up from your Phuket hotel for the drive by air-conditioned mini-van and begin your adventure at 10:00am at the rafting camp. Following Registration & whitewater rafting orientation, safety tips, briefing and training, get ready for approximately 45 minutes of whitewater rafting in a wild river. After a Lunch break, transfer transfer to the ATV camp. With Registration and tour orientation with, safety tips, briefing and ATV training finished, it is time to start riding on off-road trails amongst the great environment of local farms, plantations and jungles. The real adventure starts where the road ends, where you can experience riding in the river, which allows you to head to the hidden waterfall, secretly kept for all nature lovers. Here you will enjoy swimming, refreshments and snacks. The most exhilarating part is the adventurous up hill trails where you will ride up to the mountain peak. Here you can take a short break to enjoy the fresh, cool mountain breeze and its scenic view and take some beautiful shots of the great memories you'll keep forever. Next, you ride on off-road trails through the countryside. Then have a cool brake at our ATV camp in the village. Cool down your ATV and yourselves by riding down hill and back to the ATV camp, enjoy fresh fruits in season, a sandwich and cold beverages and transfer to your hotel.

data.name: Trekking for sunset
data.description:
Krating Cape is a beautiful viewing point on the south west coast of Phuket. It's quite difficult to get to, but if you do not mind walking 30-40 minutes past the rocks, cliffs, and steep hills, then it is definitely a place you should not miss.

​Krating Cape is known among photographers for its starlit landscapes, free from light pollution. There is a horn-shaped rock where photographers enjoy taking amazing photos. The panoramic views are very beautiful, especially during sunset. You should wear proper shoes, carry a head light, water, and wear long pants.

​

From Krating Cape you can see Nad-harn Beach and the west coast of Phuket. Next to Nad-harn is Promthep Cape at the south end of Phuket and from here you can see Coral and Racha Island.

data.name: Phuket to James Bond Island One Day Tour
data.description: This is the tour program that will bring all participants to the true nature and the island within Phang Nga Bay. The interesting place is the Tapu island (JAMES BOND ISLAND) and Panyee island. The Tapu island or “James Bond Island” is the giant standing rock sitting in the middle of the sea at the area of the front bay near the Pingkan mountain. Looking from the far, this rock looks like a giant nail, nailing deep into the seawater. This Tapu island is a very famous tourist spot in Phang Nga. Its beauty brought Hollywood to film their James Bond movie. • Admire stunningly beautiful rocky cliffs rising out of the sea in Phang Nga Bay, the world-famous “James Bond Island” • Canoeing on the shimmering waters through limestone caves and mangrove forests • Visit the Muslim fishing village on Koh Panyee, another attraction on the tour • Visit Suwan Khuha Temple, known locally as “Monkey Cave Temple” • Hassle-free pickup and drop-off from your hotel

data.description: Start your day by getting picked up around 8.00 AM from your hotel in Phuket by private car.Around 10.00 AM you will start your first activity of the day and take a trip on a bamboo raft in a rainforest down the river. Along the way, you will stop at a local farm to drink coffee from a bamboo cup, spot the flora and fauna of the jungle, and make another stop at a waterfall where you can swim. When the rafting has concluded, you can enjoy some juice and a delicious Thai dessert.Set off on an adventurous ride with an ATV quad bike around 11.30 AM for 1 hour in the jungle and sightseeing at a fruit farm. This ride is suitable for people of all levels of experience, even if you never driven an ATV before. Enjoy a delicious Thai lunch set at noon to recharge your batteries after a morning full of fun.Visit the sea turtle conservation center in the afternoon, working to save and increase the number of sea turtles in the region. The Royal Thai Navy plays an active role in turtle conservation and baby turtles are brought to the center, where they are nursed for 6-8 months before being released into the sea.To conclude your experience, you will be dropped off at your hotel in Phuket around 4.30 PM with a private taxi.

data.name: James Bond Island tour from Phuket with sea cave kayak experience
data.description: Get picked up from your Phuket hotel and board a comfortable minivan for a scenic journey to Ao Po Pier. data.name: Surin Islands by Speedboat from Khao Lak
data.description: Some of the best snorkelling sites in Thailand are off the Surin Islands. Because the area is quite remote, with clear shallow water and fewer visitors, it is the perfect island paradise!  The two Surin Islands just have a shallow channel between each other which provides a constant supply of flowing water to create perfect conditions for coral growth as well as to support the wide variety of marine life that live there AND to give you fantastic snorkelling opportunities. Here you will find yourself spending time with the likes of “Nemo” Clownfish, Octopuss, Pipefish, Coral Groupers, and many many more! Encounters with sea turtles are quite frequent here too.  A comfortable, air-conditioned mini-van transfer from your Khao Lak resort will take you to the Pier, arriving at about 7.00am. After Registration formalities, you will head out to sea for the exciting speedboat ride to the first snorkelling spot of the day. You will arrive at Surin Island at approximately 9.40am to snorkel in the crystal clear water and also you will visit Moken sea gypsy village. The Moken are an Austronesian people who live a semi-nomadic hunter-gatherer lifestyle heavily based on the sea who you will no doubt find very interesting. After this you will be taken to your second snorkelling spot and then by the beach you will enjoy a tasty Thai Buffet Lunch. Early afternoon your speedboat will move you onto the third, and final, location to do some snorkelling. It is absolutely stunning here! So stunning that it is difficult to put into words might best be described as 'beauty personified'. Approximately 2.30pm you will be head back to the Pier and transferred to your Khao Lak resort, bringing with you some wonderful memories that will stay with your forever.

data.name: Phuket Introduction City Sightseeing Tour
data.description:
Your sightseeing tour begins with morning pickup from your central Phuket hotel. Meet your friendly guide and take a comfortable seat on the air-conditioned coach for your half-day tour of southern Phuket. Admire the striking and colorful colonial architecture of Phuket town such as the Sino-Portuguese shop houses and the Sino-Colonial mansions, and learn about the many western movies that have been shot in this unique setting. 

Relax and enjoy the guided commentary as you wind though lush tropical terrain en route to several of Phuket’s stunning southern beaches. You’ll discover the distinctive atmosphere of Patong, Kata, Rawai and Karon beaches, and disembark for some memorable photos. From Karon Viewpoint, also called Three-Beach Viewpoint, you’ll catch breathtaking views of the surrounding coastline and the sparkling Andaman sea. Your tour also includes a stop at Wat Chalong Temple. Wander through the complex, marveling at the exquisite beauty of Phuket’s most important buddhist temple and pagoda. 

Your 4-hour tour ends with a hotel drop-off.

data.name: Sunset Cruise Along Phuket Coastline with BBQ Dinner
data.description: Upon embarking on the Melody, a scenic cruise along the awe-inspiring coastline of Phuket awaits. The journey leads to Promthep Cape, renowned amongst locals as the ultimate vantage point to witness the sun setting over the Land of Smiles. As the sun gracefully descends towards the horizon, it merges sea and sky in a mesmerising display of nature's grandeur. This spectacle is enjoyed with a selection of snacks and refreshments, followed by a sumptuous BBQ, Thai and Indian buffet dinner in the dining room, all set to the tune of popular music.The adventure begins with a pick-up from your hotel lobby, followed by a transfer to Ao Chalong jetty. Upon arrival, you'll check in and be greeted with a refreshing welcome drink before boarding the boat for your sunset voyage. The cruise navigates through the azure waters of the Andaman Sea, arriving at the strikingly beautiful Promthep Cape & Krating Cape. Here, you'll unwind and savour the famous sunset while our DJ sets the mood with popular music. Juices, cocktails and snacks are served as the sun slowly sinks into the Indian Ocean.The evening culminates with a delightful BBQ, Thai and Indian buffet dinner in the dining room, accompanied by soothing music as you cruise back to Phuket. The romantic journey with Melody Cruises concludes upon returning to your hotel, leaving you with memories that will last a lifetime.

data.name: Island adventure tour from Phuket with snorkelling stop
data.description: Embark on an unforgettable island adventure with a seamless hotel pick-up that whisks you away to a waiting vessel. Enjoy welcome drinks as your expert guide unveils the day's exciting itinerary. Glide across the Andaman Sea to Maya Bay, the famous location from the movie "The Beach". Marvel at towering limestone cliffs that encircle a dazzling crescent of white sand and emerald waters – a truly awe-inspiring sight.Next, plunge into the surreal beauty of Pileh Lagoon, a hidden sanctuary of vivid blue framed by dramatic cliffs. Dive into its crystal clear depths for a refreshing swim or an exhilarating leap. You'll then cruise past Viking Cave, catching glimpses of swiftlet nest harvesting. At Monkey Bay, observe energetic primates playing along the cliffs.Get ready for an underwater spectacle at Phi Phi Island, a snorkelling paradise teeming with colourful coral reefs and marine life. Let this aquatic world captivate you. Relish in a scrumptious lunch on the shores of Phi Phi Island, savour local flavours amidst striking scenery.Your journey continues to Khai Nui Island, a small tropical haven with untouched white sands and transparent waters. Snorkel directly from the boat, exploring the lively underwater ecosystem. Finally, relax on Khai Nok Island's sun-drenched beaches, where you can swim, snorkel, or simply bask in tropical bliss before a comfortable return to Phuket, filled with treasured memories of your island escape.

data.name: Phuket Island and Big Buddha Private Tour
data.description: Prepare to discover Thailand's largest island with an expert guide. On this private tour, you'll see the most popular attractions on the island such as sun-drenched beaches, the largest temple, the extraordinary Old Town, the Big Buddha statue, and much more.Get ready to see the island's most popular beach up to Karon Viewpoint for an incredible panoramic spectacle of three beaches, Kata, Kata Noi, and Karon. Then, at Promthep Cape, snap photos of the unique scenery at the island's southernmost tip. Continue your tour at Wat Chalong, one of the most venerated temples in Phuket. Stop and admire the magnificent statue of the island's Big Buddha, one of the most important and revered landmarks on the island. The large Buddha statue sits on top of the hill between Chalong and Kata and, standing 45 metres high, can be seen for miles.Head back to Phuket Town. Pop into a cashew factory to learn about one of Phuket's biggest sources of income, and uncover the streets of Phuket Old Town to admire the historic Sing-Portuguese architecture of the city. data.name: Amazing Quad Bike ATV Tour - 2 hour
data.description: It does not matter if you are new to riding or an experienced 'adrenaline junkie', you will have a great time on this ATV adventure taking you on a journey over all sorts of exciting terrain in this 350 acre (142-ha) off road area. This is a 2 hour fully guided, adrenaline-filled, exhilarating ride through plantations, jungles, a beach and more. Start your day very conveniently by being collected from your hotel in Phuket for the short, comfortable drive to where friendly experts will be waiting with your all-terrain vehicle. Upon arrival, you'll be given some safety instructions before eagerly climbing aboard in readiness for the fun and adventure ahead. Follow a knowledgeable and fully qualified guide as you ride over dirt tracks, zig-zag around the trees in the jungle and splash through big muddy puddles. It won't take too long before you will feel quite confident as you power over bumps and zoom from here to there. Along the way, pass by dense mangrove swamps, rubber plantations, and palm gardens. Take breaks to get closer looks at the environment. In the jungle here it is quite possible that you may see a Venus flytrap and, of course, want to stop to watch it capture an insect in its sticky grasp before you put your foot down to continue with your off-road experience. Suddenly you will ride out from the jungle and onto a hidden beach with brilliant white sand and azure water. Take advantage of both the break-time and the water by cooling off and relaxing. When you’re ready to head back, rev up your engine for the ride back to where it all started.

data.name: Lazy Bamboo & Phi Phi Islands Day Trip from Phuket

data.description: Take flight on Phuket’s most thrilling outdoor adventure at Skyline Flying Kamala! data.name: Phang Nga Bay Tour from Phuket including Sea Cave Canoeing
data.description: Spend a full day out on Phang Nga Bay with this small group, all inclusive tour, that provides round-trip transportation from Phuket. Visit James Bond Island, cave temples, and Koh Talu for snorkeling and kayaking.

data.name: Phuket Fantasea Cultural Theme Park
data.description: Phuket FantaSea is a Thai nighttime cultural theme park located on the island of Phuket, in the south of the country. The park covers an area of 60 acres (20 ha) and includes a Thai culture theatrical show, a theme buffet restaurant, and a shopping streetInspired by Thailand's rich and exotic heritage, Phuket Fantasea not only showcases the charm and beauty of Thailand but also enriches ancient Thai traditions with the wonder of cutting-edge technology and special effects. The result is a stunning 140-acre themed complex packed with a multitude of activities and entertainments: a carnival village with games, handicrafts, and shopping, a 4,000-seat themed restaurant offering a grand buffet of Thai and international cuisines, a breathtaking Las Vegas-style theatrical show, displaying Thailand's myths, mysteries, grace and beauty, not to mention the troupe of elephants, fire-eaters, graceful dancers, and even a tiger! This wondrous extravaganza is certain to delight the whole family.With the all the makings for a magnificent night, you can select the show with Options for Seat Type plus Hotel Transfers, International Buffet Dinner or Seafood Buffet Dinner.

data.name: Muay Thai Boxing Tickets at Patong Boxing Stadium
data.description: This ticket offers an exciting opportunity to witness Thailand’s national sport in its authentic and adrenaline-filled form. Located in the heart of Patong Beach, the stadium is renowned for hosting matches that showcase the skill, discipline, and cultural significance of Muay Thai.Enjoy electrifying bouts featuring both local and international fighters, ranging from newcomers to seasoned professionals. data.name: Flying Hanuman Ziplining Experience in Phuket with Return Transfer

data.name: Private Thai Temple Ceremony in the Morning
data.description: Start the day in a peaceful way as you visit Phuket’s most famous temple, Wat Chalong, with your guide early in the morning. Your guide will explain what is going on, and then you can participate in the morning ritual. This includes bringing food to the monks and bringing luck to your day, followed by siamsi fortune telling, and hearing stories of Thai buddhism by locals.

data.name: Big Game Fishing Expedition – Full Day at Sea
data.description: Experience the thrill of fishing at Racha Yai Island, a tropical paradise in the Andaman Sea. Compete with fellow anglers and see who manages to catch the biggest fish. Before your day ends, enjoy a delicious Thai buffet lunch onboard and take the chance to swim in the crystal blue waters. After pick up from your Phuket hotel, follow your guide to Chalong Pier and hop aboard a modern and comfortable boat for a cruise on the Andaman Sea to Racha Island. Your guide takes the boat on the high seas where you cast your line and try to get a bite. Learn from your expert guide how to catch big fish and try your luck at bagging tuna, mackerel, razorfish, grouper, or trevally. Just after midday break for a tasty lunch onboard before the chance to cool off with a swim in the azure water. You can also opt to snorkel among the colorful coral and tropical aquatic life or simply relax on the deck under the glimmering afternoon rays. After your day of adventure, return to the harbor and get a ride back to your hotel.

data.name: Phuket Introduction Tour with Hotel Pick Up
data.description: This tour is the ideal way to be introduced to some of the cultural landmarks, iconic beaches, sites and sounds of Thailand's largest island in just half a day. The tour is intended so that newcomers to Phuket will get their bearings, seeing the most popular sun-drenched beaches, the largest temple on the island, the Big Buddha and more. Everything, of course, is sparkling under the sun so you will definitely want to keep your camera handy! After you're picked up from your hotel, make your way to Patong Beach—one of the most popular beaches in the area. Take in the view of blonde sands framed by turquoise waters and framatic rock formations just offshore. From there, continue to Karon Viewpoint, where you can enjoy panoramic views of 3 beaches—Kata, Kata Noi, and Karon. Proceed to Promthep Cape, at the south end of Phuket Island, to snap photos of the breathtaking scenery of the coastline. Make your way to the neighboring Wat Chalong, one of the most venerated temples in Phuket. Admire the beautiful designs of Siamese architecture, and observe the practices of local Buddhist culture.  Lastly, head back to Phuket Town. Pop into a cashew factory to taste and shop for nutty souvenirs, and then cruise through the streets to admire the well-preserved and historic Sino-Portuguese architecture of the city. Your outing ends at the Gems Gallery, where you can opt to stay and shop before hopping on a bus to be dropped off back at your hotel.
